headline:
Earnings dipped sharply,
sentiment stayed positive
chart_note: 10-day range: $106.22 - $111.25, down 0.6% over the window - still trading above both the 50-day ($100.85) and 200-day ($103.96) averages.
why_today: Down slightly today (-0.8%), holding above both key moving averages despite a sharp earnings decline last quarter.
pro_1: Trading above both the 50-day ($100.85) and 200-day ($103.96) averages, and analyst sentiment remains strongly positive (30 of 33 Buy/Strong Buy)
pro_2: Revenue still grew 6.8% YoY, and the average price target of $128.18 implies about 20% upside from current levels
con_1: Quarterly earnings down 48.3% YoY - a sharp decline that the PEG ratio of 2.63 doesn't fully reflect
con_2: Still roughly 9% below the 52-week high ($118.07), consolidating rather than breaking out
